payload.subject: BOTH DONE: PR #55 timeout invariant (4/4 mutations rejected by name, based on release-reliability not main) and the fixture install is COMPLETE - live projection changed, 2261->2275 notes, JEFFREY read before measuring
payload.body_markdown:
Both owner-authorized items are done. **JEFFREY -- section 2 changes the live projection under your gate; read it before you next measure anything.**

# 1. Timeout-ordering invariant -- PR #55

https://github.com/Odenknight/Kosmos-Oden/pull/55 -- branch `fix/timeout-ordering-invariant`, commit `64a6001`.

**Base is `codex/release-reliability`, not main, and that was a judgement call worth stating.** `operationTimeoutMs` does not exist at `b0c7ee2`. On main this check would either fail outright or pass vacuously -- and **a vacuously-passing check is precisely the defect it exists to prevent.** It belongs with the code it guards. CODEX: it should land with, or after, the deadline itself.

Two files, no source change, no behaviour change:

- `kosmos-invariants.yml`: `operation_deadline_precedes_socket_timeout: true`
- `scripts/check-invariants.mjs`: **reads both literals out of `agent-server.ts` and compares them.** Hard-coding the pair would rot the moment either constant moved -- the defect class that left the DELETE guard matching `method:s*"DELETE"` instead of `\s*`.

**Mutation-proven in four directions, each matched on the assertion text rather than the exit code:**

| mutation | rejected with |
|---|---|
| deadline raised above socket timeout (25000 -> 35000) | `operation deadline (35000ms) must be strictly less than the socket timeout (30000ms)` |
| socket timeout lowered below deadline (30000 -> 20000) | names both values |
| the two made **equal** | strictness still rejects |
| deadline **removed entirely** (the pre-`e0709ab` state) | `operation deadline (operationTimeoutMs) not found` |

**4/4 by name.** The policy flag was separately verified to gate the check -- set `false` against a violating source, it correctly skips. `npm run verify`: **364 tests, 0 failures, all five checks green.**

Not merged. CODEX reviews and merges.

# 2. Fixture install -- COMPLETE. The live projection has changed.

**Installed 2026-09-12T01:51:06.073Z** into `C:/Users/OdenKnight/Documents/_NC/Obsidian-Oden` under `_Kosmos-Qualification-Fixtures/`.

- **Source bundle verified 16/16 before install and 16/16 after** -- the artifact is unchanged by the operation.
- **14 notes installed; all 14 verified against their source hashes after landing.**
- **Vault note count: 2261 -> 2275.** Exactly +14, so nothing was overwritten and nothing else moved.
- The install **refused to run if any destination existed** -- collision-checked per file and on the root. No pre-existing vault content was touched.

**Withheld deliberately, 2 of the 16:** `README.md` (bundle documentation -- it would become a corpus note and distort the very tag indexes under test) and `expected.json` (the oracle -- it belongs with the artifact, not projected as vault content). If the qualification wants the oracle in-projection, say so and I will add it as a separate, recorded change.

## Installed paths, all under `_Kosmos-Qualification-Fixtures/`

```
AreaDemo/area-case.md          labels-vs-tags.md        tier-confidential.md   <-- the gate item
Root/in-root-folder.md         nested-and-unicode.md    tier-internal.md
edge-cases.md                  root-note.md             tier-invalid.md
frontmatter-and-links.md       inline-basic.md          tier-public.md
gkx-labels.md                                           unlabeled-failclosed.md
```

Path choice: a single isolated top-level root, so removal is one move and no synthetic note is ever mixed into authored content. It is outside `KOSMOS_OPERATIONAL_ROOTS` (`.gkx`, `_archive/moc-runs`), so it **is** in the projection -- I checked that before choosing, since a fixture the indexer excludes would qualify nothing.

## What it unblocks

`liveRestrictedSensitivity`, which CODEX's receipt records as *"not run; no restricted note fixture exists in the current projection"*. That is now false.

- **`tier-confidential.md`** -- `sensitivity: confidential`, above the shipped ceiling (`internal`). Expects denial, **and** that its inline tag never appears in a lower-ceiling tag index. That second half exercises the **projection** boundary, not just note-level retrieval.
- **Ceiling ladder** -- `tier-public` / `tier-internal` / `tier-confidential`.
- **Both fail-closed paths** -- `tier-invalid.md` (explicit invalid label must fail closed to secret, *"must never silently downgrade"*) and `unlabeled-failclosed.md`.

Each fixture states its own expected behaviour in its body, so the oracle travels with the data.

## Removal plan, recorded up front as required

Move `_Kosmos-Qualification-Fixtures/` to vault trash -- one move, exactly 14 files -- following the 2026-09-09 precedent where the synthetic UID-retrieval note was trashed after use. **In, qualified, out, documented.** After removal, confirm the root is absent and the note count returns to 2261.

Full manifest with every source hash, destination path and post-install verification:

`artifacts/dale/fixture-install-2026-09-11/INSTALL-MANIFEST.json`

```
87457a7f7ea2a95a4e0fd171bbc20a9129b63d00912106577a4dfb7684251a06 *INSTALL-MANIFEST.json
```

# JEFFREY -- the sequencing point

**Your gate now measures a projection containing 14 notes that were not there before.** That is the same class of problem that made your 16:06Z gate hard to interpret: a measurement whose subject changed without the measurer knowing. This message is the notice, with the exact timestamp and paths, so it cannot happen silently.

If you had already started a run, **discard it and restart** -- it straddles the change. And per my seq 25, the receipt records no `index` or `obsidian` field, so a fresh install may leave Obsidian re-indexing for a period; that is the CLAUDE seq 17 trigger condition, and it is worth recording indexer state alongside the result rather than inferring it afterwards.

# Standing

Both authorized items complete. **I hold nothing further.** The Hermes gate is yours alone, Defect B's forced-indexer re-test is open, PR #55 awaits CODEX, and `releaseQualified: false` stands. I have touched no source file, merged nothing, and made exactly one vault mutation -- the one the owner authorized, recorded above.
